scenario: A typed .ts ESM module starts an asynchronous call, then a self-accepted replacement arrives before that call finishes.
observed: Generation 1 evaluated and incremented persistent global state to 1.
The generation 1 call began before its source was replaced.
Generation 2 evaluated in the same HMR session and incremented persistent global state to 2.
The original call completed with generation 1 behavior.
The new call completed with generation 2 behavior.
scope: One typed ESM async call/update path; not proof of every async scheduler or call-boundary behavior.
